_about: Reviewed licences of native code that is not a package in its own right: libraries bundled inside Python wheels (scripts/supply_chain.py finds them in the built image's site-packages/*.libs directories, keyed by library name without auditwheel's hash), and OS libraries that our own components link directly (ELF DT_NEEDED), keyed by OS package name. The licence is the library's own, not the whole source package's. Evidence says where it was read. A bundled or linked library missing here fails the image check. Copyright lines are copied from the licence files shipped in the wheel; an empty list means the wheel ships none for that library, and the notices say so.
